title: Larry Fchella asks Grant's help with a UFO briefing for Reince Priebus

tellings.quote: anyway, he um he called me up and he said after Trump won 2016, he said, "I I need to I I need to help help. We're doing a briefing for Rance Prieous." And I said, "For what UFOs?" He said, "Where are the crafts and bodies?"

plain: After Donald Trump won the 2016 election, a guest named Grant Cameron says, a man he names as Larry Fchella phoned him for help with a UFO briefing being prepared for Reince Priebus. Cameron tells Michels he asked whether the briefing was about UFOs, and Fchella asked him in reply, "Where are the crafts and bodies?" If true, it would mean people preparing to brief the incoming administration were themselves hunting for the location of recovered craft and bodies.
